data.name: Aima
data.gender_notes: Aima is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aima is the name of the mother of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) in Islamic tradition. The name Aima carries the meaning “Mother of Prophet” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aima usually hope their child will grow to embody mother of prophet and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes love, care, and nurturing as a mother.
data.etymology: Aima belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mother of Prophet.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aima total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: أيما
in_arabic.meaning: هي اسم مؤنث يرمز إلى الذكاء والخفة الإله
